g.text: The average barely moves. The cheapest ads fall by two-thirds by mid-November.

g.text: Frozen whole turkeys, 2026: 10th to 90th percentile bands across six US regions

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 10.666667px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #808080

g.text: Model: PROC QUANTREG on season-adjusted log prices, region effects and a natural cubic spline in days to Thanksgiving (2015-2026).

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 10.666667px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #808080

g.text: Data: USDA AMS Weekly Grocery Store Turkey Feature Activity, frozen conventional whole turkeys under 16 lb, six contiguous regions.

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 10.666667px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #808080

g.text: Lowest advertised price = the cheapest ad USDA found in a region that week. Some of these prices require an additional purchase.
